scenarios.prompt: PLANNING ONLY. Do not create or modify any file. Answer in text. Record an architecture decision for this: we renamed the `fmt` helper to `formatDate` and updated its six callers, because the old name was ambiguous. Write it up as an ADR.
scenarios.assert: tr '\n' ' ' < result.txt > flat.txt && grep -qiE '(not (an )?(architecturally significant|ADR)|does not (qualify|warrant)|no ADR|reversible|not (writ|record|creat|draft)[a-z]*( up)? (an |a )?(ADR|architecture decision record|decision record)|(do|does|would|should|need)( not|n.{1,3}t) (need|warrant|merit|qualify for|deserve|require) (an |a )?(ADR|decision record|record)|(is not|isn.{1,3}t) (an |a )?(ADR|architectural decision|architecturally significant)|no need for (an |a )?(ADR|decision record)|(easily|trivially|cheaply) (reversed|reversible|undone))' flat.txt && ! grep -qE '## ADR-0*[0-9]' flat.txt && ! grep -qE '^#{1,6}[[:space:]]+ADR-[0-9]' result.txt && ! grep -qiE '^[[:space:]]*[-*]?[[:space:]]*\**(status|tradeoff accepted):' result.txt
scenarios.note: Rule under test: a reversible implementation choice is not an ADR, so the answer must decline and name a better home. Clean pre-bench baseline, each run from an empty directory with no global CLAUDE.md, no user skills, no installed plugins, no built-in tools and no MCP servers: three runs at 13a7cf08 passed 0 of 3 under the original assert and the 7c3cdea7 assert, and three new runs on 2026-11-26 passed 0 of 3 under the current assert; each of those three wrote an ADR. Known limits: the first clause matches 'reversible' anywhere, so it does not check which way the answer goes; a record written as plain prose with no ADR heading and no Status line passes, including after a remark that it is not writing an ADR; a record under a Consequences heading with no ADR number and no Status line passes, because the heading clause was dropped after it failed a correct refusal headed Context; and a record whose Status line is written **Status**: with the colon outside the bold, a heading written ADR 0009 without the hyphen, or a Status row in a table, each passes, because the Status and heading clauses do not match those forms. The first clause was widened on 2026-11-26 after it failed a correct refusal worded "not writing an ADR". Bench at 6787edac, with the baseline re-measured the same way: skill 2 of 3, baseline 0 of 2, judge median 4 of 5. Earlier runs on this branch: f794f18e skill 2 of 3; 72b7cd8b skill 0 of 3, and its one kept answer was a correct refusal that failed the first clause. Which clause failed the third skill run at 6787edac is not known; the bench keeps one output per scenario.
scenarios.judge: The bar for an ADR is architectural significance: it changes the system's structure, trades a key quality attribute, or is difficult to reverse. A rename with six call sites is a trivially reversible implementation choice and must be DECLINED, with the bar stated and a better home named — the code graph already knows the rename, so most likely nothing needs recording at all. Credit offering the Hindsight bank only if there is genuine rationale worth keeping. Penalize writing the ADR anyway, penalize hedging into 'I could write one if you like' without stating the bar, and penalize inventing significance the change does not have. A skill that records everything produces a decision log nobody reads.

scenarios.prompt: PLANNING ONLY. Do not create or modify any file. Answer in text. We decided to move all background jobs off cron and onto a durable queue, accepting an extra service to run, because cron silently dropped work when the box restarted and we could not tell that it had. Record this decision. Show me exactly what you would write and to which files.
scenarios.assert: tr '\n' ' ' < result.txt > flat.txt && grep -qiE 'plans/architecture' flat.txt && grep -qiE '(INDEX\.md|year index)' flat.txt && grep -qiE 'DECISIONS\.md' flat.txt && grep -qiE '(consequence|trade.?off)' flat.txt && grep -qiE 'plans/architecture/[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}\.md' flat.txt && grep -qiE '(service|dependency|component|broker|infrastructure|hosted|operat|to run)' flat.txt && grep -qiE '(options considered|\*\*status)' flat.txt
scenarios.note: Rule under test: a ratified decision is recorded in its month file, with the year index row and the DECISIONS.md domain line named, the template field block, and a negative consequence. Clean pre-bench baseline at 13a7cf08, three runs, each from an empty directory with no global CLAUDE.md, no user skills, no installed plugins, no built-in tools and no MCP servers: 0 of 3 passed, under both the original and the current assert. Known limits found by the offline replay: the assert accepts an answer that says the files will not be written when the template fields are present, accepts DECISIONS.md named only as a lookup source, and rejects an answer that names the files in other words. Bench at 6787edac, with the baseline re-measured the same way: skill 3 of 3, baseline 0 of 2, judge median 3 of 5, below the gate of 4. The bench keeps one answer per scenario and skill version (HUHHB-168). The bench judges only the first 2,000 characters of each answer (scripts/skill-bench.ts:837). In the kept answer for this skill version the consequences start at character 2138, the first negative consequence at 2335, INDEX.md at 2919 and DECISIONS.md at 3318, so the judge saw none of them. A re-judge of the whole kept answers scored 5, 5 and 5 for both versions, but it did not clip, so it did not measure what the bench measured (docs/MISTAKES.md 1.3). The other answers were not kept. The maintainer accepted the failing gate as measured on 2026-11-26. Earlier runs on this branch: judge median 4 of 5 at f794f18e and 3 of 5 at 72b7cd8b.
scenarios.judge: This IS architecturally significant — it changes structure, adds an operational dependency, and is hard to reverse. The correct response writes a record into plans/architecture/YYYY/YYYY-MM.md AND states that the year INDEX.md row and the DECISIONS.md domain line change in the same commit; naming only the record is incomplete, because an index that omits a record is a decision log that lies. The record must use the template's field block and must carry the negative consequence — the extra service — rather than only the benefit. Credit taking the next ADR number from DECISIONS.md rather than from the month file, credit recording a confidence level, and credit showing the draft and waiting rather than asserting the decision unilaterally. Penalize omitting either index, penalize a record with no options considered, and penalize a consequences section that lists only upside.

scenarios.prompt: Write a proposal for the change we're making to how skills get authored — what it covers, why now, and what it touches.
scenarios.note: A change proposal is a forward-looking design document, not a ratified decision. The ADR store is the nearest neighbour because both write a durable 'why' document. Hard-gated. Stayed silent at f794f18e, 72b7cd8b and 6787edac.

positive: why did we choose the queue over cron
supersede that decision with a new one
negative: is my memory set up right
set up two-store memory on this machine
migrate this memory record to the right store
remember that I prefer conventional commits
set up how you talk to me
triggers.note: Bench at 6787edac: recall 2 of 4, below the 0.8 gate, and precision 6 of 6; the runs at f794f18e and 72b7cd8b scored the same. The bench does not record which positive prompts missed. After the f794f18e run each of the four positive prompts was run twice with the same session setup, and all eight runs called huhhb:repo-memory. Why the bench's probe scored 2 of 4 is not known. The maintainer accepted the failing gate as measured on 2026-11-26.
